glossary.definition: (A) "Alcohol and other drug abuse" means alcohol use disorder or drug addiction.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Another drug" means a controlled substance as defined in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code or a harmful intoxicant as defined in section 2925.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Board of alcohol, drug addiction, and mental health services" means a board of alcohol, drug addiction, and mental health services established under section 340.02 or 340.021 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: board of alcohol, drug addiction, and mental health services
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:
glossary.term: Board of alcohol, drug addiction, and mental health services

glossary.definition: (D) "Danger" or "threat of danger to self, family, or others" means substantial physical harm or threat of substantial physical harm upon self, family, or others.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Danger" or "threat of danger to self, family, or others" means substantial physical harm or threat of substantial physical harm upon self, family, or others.
glossary.normalized: threat of danger to self, family, or others
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:
glossary.term: threat of danger to self, family, or others

glossary.definition: (E) "Hospital" has the same meaning as in section 3701.01 or 3727.01 of the Revised Code but does not include either a hospital operated by the department of behavioral health or an inpatient unit licensed by the department.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Intoxicated" means being under the influence of alcohol, another drug, or both alcohol and another drug and, as a result, having a significantly impaired ability to function.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Petitioner" means a person who institutes a proceeding under sections 5119.91 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Probate court" means the probate division of the court of common pleas.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Qualified health professional" means a person that is properly credentialed or licensed to conduct a drug and alcohol assessment and diagnosis under Ohio law.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Residence" means the legal residence of a person as determined by applicable principles governing conflicts of law.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (K) "Respondent" means a person alleged in a petition filed or hearing under sections 5119.91 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code to be a person who is experiencing alcohol and other drug abuse and who may be ordered under those sections to undergo treatment.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 5119.90 to 5119.98 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(L) "Treatment" means services and programs for the care and rehabilitation of intoxicated persons and persons experiencing alcohol and other drug abuse. "Treatment" includes residential treatment, a halfway house setting, and an intensive outpatient or outpatient level of care.
